test_objective: Check that you cannot query context source registration subscriptions with invalid page and limit parameters
keywords: Query Context Source Registration Subscriptions With Invalid Limit And Page Parameters

test_cases.name: 041_04_01 Invalid Limit
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot query context source registration subscriptions with invalid page and limit parameters
test_cases.template: Query Context Source Registration Subscriptions With Invalid Limit And Page Parameters
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceSubscriptions'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Context Source Registration Subscriptions and
    Query Parameter: limit set to '${-5}' and
    Query Parameter: page set to '${2}'
}
